messages:
olivia: Quick sync  prepping launch posts + webinar funnel. Need owners for keyword targets, schema, internal linking, redirects, and lead routing.

kevin: I can take keyword mapping and redirects. Plan: one landing per intent, 301 legacy posts -> canonical, preserve UTM query params, mark experiment routes as 302. Will upload CSV to the ticket.

sam: I'll own structured data. Event JSON-LD on the webinar LP, FAQPage for the benchmark post, BreadcrumbList on longform. Will drop CMS-ready JSON-LD snippets.

nora: Tracking & routing: utm_content values = webinar_cta / bench_cta / kit_cta. Map utm_content=webinar_cta -> Sales Queue A; bench_cta -> SDR nurture. Thank-you pages should be noindex. Persist UTM via server-side session cookie across redirects.

kevin: Redirect examples (nginx):
```
# direct migrate old article to new landing
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch-2026/$1 permanent;
# register fallback to webinar LP
location /register { try_files $uri $uri/ /webinar-lp; }
```
I'll audit for chains and convert intermediate hops to single 301s.

sam: Schema note: include `mainEntity` FAQ array (top 6 Qs) on benchmark to surface rich results. Also add Event `location` as VirtualLocation with webinar URL.

olivia: Internal linking: add two contextual links from product docs and three from the benchmark post to the main landing. Use anchors: "Register", "Read benchmark", "Get starter kit". Avoid linking to thank-you pages or ephemeral experiment URLs.

nora: Analytics events to instrument: `cta_click`, `register_submit`, `lead_complete`. Use distinct utm_content on each CTA variant and map to routing matrix.

build-bot: Deploy started for branch `marketing/webinar-funnel` - preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch-preview. Running staging crawl and structured data validation.

kevin: After staging crawl I'll run a link-equity check. If any 3xx chains >1 hop appear we'll flatten to direct 301s to preserve signals.

olivia: Ownership recap: kevin = canonical map + redirects; sam = schema + JSON-LD; nora = UTMs + lead routing; olivia = content signoff + CRO experiments. Sync tomorrow 10:00am to review staging crawl results. :calendar:
